replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I rarely get anxious about math. My high conscientiousness and neuroticism scores mean I stay focused on tasks. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for quick calculations and to verify solutions. It helped me understand concepts faster without overwhelming me. I found it efficient and reliable, especially for checking answers during self-study.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; zero, one solution; negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a). This method works for all cases.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f’(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Plug the x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they’re maxima or minima using the second derivative test. This helps identify critical points on the graph.
